summary: Capital scarcity re-strengthened as the US 10Y returned to ~5% while oil remained above $100. The most important new micro evidence is the contrast between funded physical AI power demand (Generac/Amazon) and stressed AI project debt (Oracle Project Jupiter). Nuclear fuel contracting also strengthened via Cameco-linked enrichment procurement. No holding fundamental score changed; TTWO broke decisively below the prior ~$210 reassessment line.
whatIsNewNow: US 10Y returned to ~5% after the post-Fed relief; S&P +0.17%, Nasdaq +0.40%, Dow -0.18%, Russell 2000 -0.5%, showing narrow resilience rather than broad risk-on.

Generac signed a long-term Amazon data-centre backup-generator agreement with $2.4B initial 2027-28 deliveries; Amazon warrants vest against qualifying purchases up to $8B through 2033. This is high-quality funded physical-power confirmation, but GNRC has already repriced sharply.

About $18B of loans tied to Oracle-leased Project Jupiter data-centre debt were quoted around 89-91 cents as syndication stalled; this is direct evidence that AI financing quality is becoming a market transmission channel.
Cameco will buy planned output from Global Laser Enrichment's Paducah enrichment facility, adding fuel-cycle contracting evidence.
AI-enabled cyber incidents/testing strengthened the selective cybersecurity/governance thesis; treat incidents as demand evidence, not direct company score weight.
RoboTechnik's planned Hong Kong secondary listing adds a China/HK automation + silicon-photonics equipment candidate, but +166% YTD Shenzhen performance makes it research-only rather than an entry.

themeRanking.theme: AI Financing Quality vs Funded Physical Infrastructure
themeRanking.whyNow: Oracle-linked Project Jupiter debt is stressed while Amazon's Generac order provides a clean funded-demand counterexample.
themeRanking.marketTransmission: AI project debt, bank balance sheets, capex, supplier backlog, valuation dispersion.
themeRanking.confirmation: More debt trades below par/covenants tighten while funded supplier orders continue converting.
themeRanking.invalidation: Project debt clears easily and financing stress fails to spread.
themeRanking.nextTest: Oracle project financing, hyperscaler debt/CDS, supplier backlog and FCF.
themeRanking.action: Promote GNRC to priority research but do not chase post-deal gap; penalize unfunded AI capacity.
